_README: ECS Fargate task definition for the Vedhic Foods backend.
Every value written as REPLACE_ME must be substituted before registering this
REPLACE_ME marker survives, so a template cannot be deployed by accident.
REPLACE_ME_EXECUTION_ROLE  role the ECS AGENT uses: ECR pull + secrets read
REPLACE_ME_TASK_ROLE       role the APP runs as: S3 + SES + secrets read
REPLACE_ME_IMAGE           ECR image URI including the :tag
REPLACE_ME_SECRET_ARN_*    ARNs of secrets created by infra/scripts/create-secrets.ps1
Deliberately NOT templated: no secret VALUES appear here. Secrets are
referenced by ARN in the `secrets` block, so the JSON is safe to commit.
Every REPLACE_ME marker above is detected by
infra/validate-task-definition.ps1, which exits non-zero while any remain.
_ARCHITECTURE_NOTE: arm64 is roughly 20% cheaper per vCPU-hour on Fargate and this workload is
pure Node.js I/O with no native x86-only dependencies. Prisma ships a musl
arm64 query engine, and the Dockerfile builds on the same architecture, so no
emulation is involved. Switch to x86_64 only if a future native dependency

containerDefinitions.name: backend
_ENV_NOTE: Only non-secret configuration lives in `environment`. Anything sensitive
REDIS_URL is required: rate limiting fails the boot without it, because the
express-rate-limit default store is per-process and silently multiplies
every limit by the task count.
TRUST_PROXY must be the number of proxies in front of the app. With an ALB
in awsvpc mode it is 1. Getting this wrong makes every request appear to
come from the proxy, which collapses per-IP rate limiting to a single
FRONTEND_URL / ADMIN_FRONTEND_URL are the COMPLETE production CORS
allowlist. src/config/env.ts refuses to boot unless both are real https
origins that are not loopback or reserved names, and app.ts adds nothing
else in production. Keep this list in step with the storefront and admin
_SECRETS_NOTE: Injected by the ECS agent at container start from Secrets Manager. Values
are never visible in `describe-task-definition`, only the ARNs are.
DATABASE_URL must include `sslmode=require`. RDS refuses non-TLS
connections unless the instance parameter group allows otherwise, and an
unencrypted connection would expose credentials in transit.
Each entry is exactly the ECS `Secret` shape ({ name, valueFrom }). The
agent resolves and injects every secret BEFORE the container's ENTRYPOINT
runs, so the app can never boot against a half-populated environment.
`dependsOn` is NOT valid here - it belongs on the container definition and
is rejected by register-task-definition inside a secret object.
